action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match")
    if not np.all(logp_with_result <= 0) or not np.all(logp_call_only <= 0) or not np.all(logp_no_call <= 0):
        raise ValueError("Input values must be nonpositive")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("Input values must be finite")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric type")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if future_horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("future_horizon must be positive")

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    if weight_sum == 0:
        weights = np.ones(future_horizon) / future_horizon
    else:
        weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Compute weighted sums
    sum_with = logp_with_result @ weights
    sum_call = logp_call_only @ weights
    sum_none = logp_no_call @ weights

    # Convert to losses
    loss_with = -sum_with
    loss_call = -sum_call
    loss_none = -sum_none

    # Compute margin and keep mask
    baseline_loss = np.minimum(loss_call, loss_none)
    margins = baseline_loss - loss_with
    keep_mask = margins > tau_filter

    return keep_mask, margins.astype(float)
